review_mode: labeled visual review, not blind direction certification

method.basis: Direct visual inspection of the Gu and Feng contact sheets, labeled look sheets, all six transition sheets, and the Gu Idle versus Running comparison. Numerical geometry did not substitute for pose approval.
method.capture_type: Electron capturePage window captures; captured-window GIF sequences are not OS-compositor video.
method.mutations: This review JSON only. No image generation, redraw, frozen-pixel edits, runtime changes, commits, packaging, or application replacement.
method.diagnostic_candidates: Endpoint rigid diagnostic candidates are not treated as runtime evidence or approved replacements.

issues.judgment: Gu Waving, Failed, Waiting, Running and Review shoes now sit on the same apparent grounded baseline as Idle. Running is still a slightly more compact head/upper-body drawing; this is not a remaining foot-registration defect and is not approved as transition-pose continuity.

Feng Failed retains the chin-hand stance and nearly unchanged shoulders/torso across the eight displayed cells. Eye closure and a small head change are visible, but the row reads as a restrained thinking/blink pose rather than a clear failure reaction.

Feng Idle has visible eye micro-variation, while chest, shoulder and stance movement are very slight. The sheet supports a quiet blink loop, but does not establish a readily visible breath. Manual acceptance of this restraint remains required.

Before to forward frame 0 changes Gu's head/face/shoulder drawing and horizontal registration. Held Running is the clearest case: the grounded work figure changes abruptly into a taller-head endpoint drawing despite the shoes remaining grounded. Hover also resets its head orientation. Idle shows a smaller but visible repositioning/alternate drawing. These are endpoint pose changes, not merely moving hands or the intentional Gu-to-Feng growth in frames 2-4.

Reverse frame 7 to after changes Gu's head/face/upper-body drawing and lateral position. In held Running the final transition figure has a taller head silhouette than the recovered work figure at the same shoe baseline. Hover adds an abrupt gaze/pose change; Idle also visibly shifts. Earlier Feng shrinking and the hand lowering are coherent transformation/gesture changes, but do not resolve the final endpoint handoff.

Forward frame 1 to 2 introduces a prominent full-body cyan outline, followed by a much larger bright burst at frame 3. Reverse frame 6 still has conspicuous white residual sparks, then frame 7 is clean. The material effect stages remain stepped; their optical cadence cannot be certified from still sheets.

The labeled Feng 000/up pose remains largely frontal and the face/chin does not clearly aim upward at the displayed size. By contrast, 022.5-067.5 show a raised chin and an obvious upward profile. I cannot certify 000 as unmistakably up from this image. This is a labeled visual judgment, not a blind classification result.

gu.identity: Same black hair, glasses, navy suit and slim build remain recognizable. The work-family head drawing is slightly more compact than Idle, but no within-row anatomical scaling drift is evident in the inspected sheets.
gu.running_right_and_left: Opposite head/body orientations and visibly different leg positions; still sheets do not certify optical gait cadence.
gu.waving: Raised hand is normal gesture motion, not size drift.
gu.jumping: Small vertical hop changes position rather than anatomical size.
gu.failed: Lowered head/shoulders read as dejection; this lean is not size drift.
gu.waiting: Eye/head variation is subtle and state distinction is weak.
gu.running: Grounded focused hand motion rather than literal foot-running.
gu.review: Hand to face and head lean remain attached and coherent.

feng.identity: Blue suit, glasses, muscular shoulders, face and stance remain recognizable across the standard rows. Arm motion, leaning and the small hop do not show conspicuous anatomical scaling drift.
feng.idle: Weak breath cue; V-03 remains manual.
feng.running_right_and_left: Facing and alternating leg poses are visible; optical cadence remains unverified.
feng.waving: Hand raises beside the head without apparent body-size change.
feng.jumping: Small vertical hop preserves the stance and body construction.
feng.failed: Weak failure expression; V-02 remains unresolved.
feng.waiting_and_running: Mostly preserve the chin-hand thinking stance, with subtle face variation; state distinction is restrained.
feng.review: Hand lowers and returns with a small head change; this is gesture motion rather than anatomical drift.

row_review.scope_limit: The inspected sheets show populated, recognizable figures with no conspicuous body collapse. This statement does not replace alpha, clipping, atlas, or source-integrity validation.

gu.continuity: Feet and lower torso remain broadly anchored. Head yaw advances from right through down to left; no conspicuous scale pop or gross reversal is visible in the ordered stills. Near-vertical diagonals are subtle.

summary: V-01 grounded registration is visually improved. V-04 and V-05 remain P1 endpoint pose/registration discontinuities, and Feng 000/up is not visually certifiable as an unmistakable cardinal. V-02, V-03 and V-06 remain P2 artistic/manual limitations. No release candidate is visually approved.
